_description: GLORIA MRIO analysis configuration. All paths are relative to 07_gloria_mrio/. gloria_mrio and satellite inputs come from Stage 6 (06_gloria_mapping/); results are written to ./output/ alongside this folder.

_comments.paths: Inputs come from 06_gloria_mapping. Override via --config on the command line if your layout differs.
_comments.target_sectors: 0-based GLORIA sector indices; see Supplementary Table S8.1.
_comments.region_grouping: 'individual' for 164 separate regions, 'all' for a single global group, or a custom dict keyed by group name.
_comments.indicators: Row indices into the satellite TQ table (0 = irrigated crop water stress for the current release).
